title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Nickboss WordPress…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the Nickboss WordPress File Upload plugin (wp-file-upload) up to version 5.3.1. This flaw allows an attacker to bypass directory restrictions and access or modify files outside the intended directory. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.6, indicating a significant impact on availability but no direct confidentiality or integrity loss is reported.
